audit.why: Difficulty EVEN at 5.5/10 matches the 52.19% win rate over 2462 games. Karma has no dash and no hard engage; Irelia's threat is gated only by Focused Resolve landing.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike prose ignored real cooldowns: Mantra is 40/38/36/34s and Focused Resolve is a flat 12s, which is what actually sets the step-up window.
audit.why: Concrete cooldowns make the spike advice actionable instead of directional.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns now carries Mantra 40s at rank 1, Focused Resolve flat 12s, Bladesurge 6s at rank 5, Defiant Dance 12s.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page never states the decisive interactions: Defiant Dance's damage reduction against the Mantra-empowered Inner Flame cataclysm, Focused Resolve's tether breaking on distance/line of sight, and Mantra-Focused Resolve healing Karma.
audit.why: Karma's only lockdown is the tether; Irelia's whole pattern is scheduled around it. Karma's heal off Mantra-W is why Grievous Wounds matters in extended trades.
audit.corrected: Stated in winCon, dosFull[0].d, dontsFull[1].d, breakdown.mid (anti-heal) and breakdown.cooldowns.
